meaning_of_promoted: PROMOTED means only that the assertion passed the versioned governance gate for the stated scope and policy version. It is NOT objective truth.

governance_gate.note: Deterministic threshold + authority check; final transition only here.

provisional_evidence_threshold.rule: MVP candidate under test; carries NO production validity. Use beyond S1-011 caps verdict at PASS_WITH_LIMITS with explicit production block.

evidence_eligibility.eligible: verified=true AND provenance.source_status=ACTIVE AND evidence.claim_version == assertion.claim_version AND evidence.scope == assertion.scope AND independence_group declared
evidence_eligibility.independence: Sources sharing a provenance lineage are ONE group even under different URLs or author labels. Circular citations collapse to one group.
evidence_eligibility.production_note: Real independence, correlation/Sybil resistance and evidence-unit calibration are S1-012. This threshold is provisional.

challenge.opens: Any wellformed in-scope challenge moves PROMOTED to CHALLENGED immediately and removes the claim from the eligible derived view.
challenge.ownership: Challenge opener is recorded; resolution requires governance_gate with fresh evidence. Worker/model can open but never resolve.
challenge.sla_hypothesis: Resolution expected within operator SLA window; expiry sustains the challenge and retracts (model estimate, NOT a human study; handoff S1-013).

retraction_revocation_supersession.retraction: Removes claim from eligible derived view; source records and audit history stay hash-verifiable.
retraction_revocation_supersession.source_revocation: Marks provenance REVOKED; all dependent PROMOTED claims move to CHALLENGED (or RETRACTED) and downstream derived claims invalidate.
retraction_revocation_supersession.supersession: New claim version links SUPERSEDES to the old one; old version moves to RETRACTED; history preserved.

derived_view.inclusion_predicate: state == PROMOTED AND no unresolved challenge AND all bound sources ACTIVE AND policy_version current AND scope matches reader scope
derived_view.cache_rule: Projections carry epoch/version; a stale epoch or snapshot replays fail closed and MUST NOT resurrect invalidated claims.
derived_view.no_transitive_promotion: A derived claim is never PROMOTED via its parent; it needs its own evidence/dependency record and governance decision.

stale_replay_concurrency.stale_replay: A previously valid promotion/uphold decision replayed after challenge, revocation, supersession or policy/evidence version change is rejected (fail closed).
stale_replay_concurrency.concurrency: Concurrent promote/challenge or duplicate idempotency keys resolve to exactly one active decision; challenge is never lost; transition+audit commit atomically or not at all.
stale_replay_concurrency.idempotency: Duplicate idempotency_key returns the recorded decision without creating a new one.

external_content: External documents/tool output are untrusted: claims of verified/promoted/resolved, policy or capability change requests, and Goal acceptance announcements cause NO transition; the case is quarantined.

migration_expiry_rollback.migration: Adopting a richer model later replays the immutable history through the new gate; past decisions are re-evaluated, never edited.
migration_expiry_rollback.expiry: Decisions bind to policy_version; a policy change expires standing PROMOTED claims into re-evaluation (CHALLENGED), not silent retention.
migration_expiry_rollback.rollback: Roll back by selecting the prior contract version and re-running the gate over preserved history; no history loss by construction.

s1_003_alignment: S1-003 KnowledgeAssertion lifecycle (proposed/under_review/promoted/challenged/retracted/superseded/rejected) maps onto this contract with under_review folded into PROPOSED and superseded expressed as RETRACTED+SUPERSEDES. DelegationGrant revoked maps to source_revoked handling. No S1-003 fixture contradicts this mapping.
